caption:
Before you hire anyone for your website, ask these four questions.

Will I own it?
Can I see what it brings in?
Who do I call when something breaks?
Was it made for my business?

Those are our answers on the slide. Ask anyone you're talking to for theirs.

Let's talk. Link in bio.
